hero.lead: VicTy turns what you believe about the future into an investment you understand. Describe a belief, see which instruments can represent it and why, and decide what to buy — one asset at a time, from your own wallet.

example.label: Example
example.thesis: AI will reshape data center infrastructure over the next 5 years, but I don't want to depend on a single company.
example.footer: You edit the weights and reject what you don't want.

problem.title: You have a conviction. A list of tokens doesn't help.

cards.title: Which assets represent the idea?
cards.body: A belief rarely maps to one token. Finding the ones that actually carry the exposure takes research most people don't have time for.

cards.title: What does this token really represent?
cards.body: Issuer, backing, rights, limits. A ticker tells you none of it, and the difference matters.

cards.title: How much of each, and what does it cost?
cards.body: Splitting a budget, understanding fees, slippage and routes before signing — without putting everything in one place.

how.title: From a belief to a position you understand
how.lead: Your wallet only comes in when you decide to buy.

steps.title: Describe
steps.body: Write what you believe in, or start from a suggested thesis.

steps.title: Confirm what we understood
steps.body: We show the exposures, exclusions and limits we read. You correct them before any asset is proposed.

steps.title: Review the composition
steps.body: Only reviewed instruments, each with what it represents and why it's there. Change weights or reject assets.

steps.title: Invest one asset at a time
steps.body: Review each buy — amount, route, fees, slippage — and sign it in your wallet. Then follow your plan against what you hold.

instruments.title: Know what you're buying before you buy it
instruments.lead: Every instrument comes from a small, curated catalog we've reviewed. The AI reads your thesis; it never picks tokens on its own.
instruments.note: When a thesis can't be represented well enough, we say so — instead of suggesting something that only looks similar.

rows.value: The economic exposure the token actually carries.
Who issues it and what holding it entitles you to.
How it connects to the thesis you confirmed.
What it doesn't cover, and its known costs.
Whether there's a buy and sell route right now.

cards.title: Your keys, your funds
cards.body: VicTy never holds your assets or keys. Every buy and sell is signed in your own wallet.

cards.title: One decision at a time
cards.body: No automatic rebalancing and no "buy all". You choose what to buy and when.

cards.title: Real numbers only
cards.body: Positions come from confirmed transactions. When a price or cost is missing, we show that it's missing.

audience.title: For people who already use a Solana wallet
need: Nothing to explore theses and see how they can be represented.
To invest: a Solana wallet you control, with funds on Solana.
isnt: Not a swap screen or a token list.
Not a robo-advisor: nothing is bought or rebalanced for you.

cta.title: What do you believe in?
cta.lead: No wallet, no funds, no signature until you decide to invest.
